term: epistemic policy of worldviews one ought to adopt
definition: OughtAdopt is an uninterpreted predicate selecting candidate worldviews as normatively recommended. The consistency norm applies the reusable self-application Norm schema to those selections with Consistent as its standard; the duty-compatibility norm instead uses joint compatibility with a specified duty-content. No deontic closure, obligation to believe every consequence, or actual normative authority is built into OughtAdopt.
note: The user's objective-duty proposal is investigated conditionally, not attributed to a source or asserted as an independently established moral or epistemic fact. Reuses DEF-SELF-APPLICATION-NORM and identifies an additional needed bridge.
